sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: And this, of course, is the theme for one of the most epic training sequences of all time.
sentences.zh: 当然，这段音乐是有史以来最史诗级的训练片段之一的主题曲。

sentences.en: It's from the 1976 movie Rocky, and it plays as the struggling boxer in Philadelphia, Rocky Balboa,
sentences.zh: 它出自1976年的电影《洛奇》，当费城的落魄拳击手洛奇·巴尔博亚在片中登场时，音乐便响起了，

sentences.en: builds his strength for the big fight by doing one-arm push-ups
sentences.zh: 他通过做单臂俯卧撑来增强力量，

sentences.en: and using a giant slab of raw meat as a punching bag.
sentences.zh: 并把一大块生肉当作沙袋来练习。

sentences.en: The training montage ends with him bounding up the 72 steps of the Philadelphia Museum of Art.
sentences.zh: 训练蒙太奇的结尾，他奔跑着冲上了费城艺术博物馆的72级台阶。

sentences.en: The camera's panning around him, and he raises his fists up victoriously.
sentences.zh: 摄像机围绕着他旋转，他胜利地举起了双拳。

sentences.en: This is producer Justin Crayman.
sentences.zh: 我是制作人贾斯汀·克雷曼。

sentences.en: Until I re-watched the movie recently, I'd pretty much forgotten everything else about it.
sentences.zh: 直到最近重温这部电影之前，我几乎已经忘记了关于它的其他一切。

sentences.en: Like, this moment is my image of the film.
sentences.zh: 比如，这一幕就是我心目中这部电影的形象。

sentences.en: Rocky jumping up and down in front of the museum, arms raised, all of Philly below him.
sentences.zh: 洛奇在博物馆前跳上跳下，双臂高举，整个费城都在他脚下。

sentences.en: Rocky's run up the steps becomes this iconic moment,
sentences.zh: 洛奇跑上台阶成了标志性的时刻，

sentences.en: and pretty much immediately, people who run up the steps as part of their exercise routine in Philadelphia
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，那些把跑台阶作为日常锻炼一部分的费城人，

sentences.en: become associated with Rocky.
sentences.zh: 就与洛奇联系在了一起。

sentences.en: And it becomes recognized as this fan practice where people are responding to the film
sentences.zh: 这演变成了一种粉丝习俗，人们通过这种方式回应电影，

sentences.en: and they're running up the steps.
sentences.zh: 他们跑上台阶。

sentences.en: Laura Holzman teaches art history and museum studies at Indiana University.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·霍尔兹曼在印第安纳大学教授艺术史和博物馆学。

sentences.en: She's written about Rocky's legacy in Philadelphia cultural history.
sentences.zh: 她曾撰文探讨过洛奇在费城文化史上的遗产。

sentences.en: And in Rocky 2, the movie acknowledges the prominence of this fan practice
sentences.zh: 在《洛奇2》中，电影认可了这种粉丝习俗的重要性，

sentences.en: because he repeats the run up the steps,
sentences.zh: 因为他再次跑上了台阶，

sentences.en: and this time he's joined by a group of kids as he runs up the stairs.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，在他奔跑时，一群孩子加入了他的行列。

sentences.en: Today, at the top of those iconic steps in front of the art museum
sentences.zh: 今天，在艺术博物馆前那些标志性台阶的顶端，

sentences.en: stands an eight-and-a-half-foot-tall statue of Rocky Balboa,
sentences.zh: 矗立着一座八英尺半高的洛奇·巴尔博亚雕像，

sentences.en: a gift to the city of Philadelphia from the film's star, Sylvester Stallone.
sentences.zh: 这是电影主演西尔维斯特·史泰龙送给费城市的一份礼物。

sentences.en: It's a bronze sculpture, and it depicts Rocky dressed like a boxer in that same victorious stance.
sentences.zh: 这是一座青铜雕塑，描绘了洛奇穿着拳击手装束，摆出那同样的胜利姿势。

sentences.en: Standing on a one-and-a-half-foot base,
sentences.zh: 它矗立在一座一英尺半高的底座上，

sentences.en: this chiseled gladiator towers over the Benjamin Franklin Parkway,
sentences.zh: 这位轮廓分明的角斗士高耸在本杰明·富兰克林大道之上，

sentences.en: a stretch of Philly that's home to some of the city's most famous museums and cultural sites.
sentences.zh: 这是费城的一段路，汇集了该市一些最著名的博物馆和文化场所。

sentences.en: That location really highlights just how important the statue is in the city.
sentences.zh: 那个位置确实凸显了这座雕像在城市中的重要性。

sentences.en: Around four million people visit the Rocky statue every year,
sentences.zh: 每年约有四百万人参观洛奇雕像，

sentences.en: about the same as the Statue of Liberty.
sentences.zh: 人数与参观自由女神像的差不多。

sentences.en: When Stallone first gave the statue to Philly,
sentences.zh: 当史泰龙最初把雕像送给费城时，

sentences.en: this is exactly where he wanted it to live,
sentences.zh: 这正是他希望它安放的地方，

sentences.en: at the top of the museum's steps, fists high,
sentences.zh: 在博物馆台阶的顶端，双拳高举，

sentences.en: looking over the city, just like the movie.
sentences.zh: 俯瞰着这座城市，就像电影里一样。

sentences.en: But it would be decades before this became the Rocky statue's permanent home.
sentences.zh: 但还要过几十年，这里才成为洛奇雕像的永久家园。

sentences.en: Because what started as a simple gesture of gratitude,
sentences.zh: 因为最初这只是一个简单的感恩姿态，

sentences.en: and possibly a bit of self-aggrandizement,
sentences.zh: 或许还带有一点自我吹嘘的意味，

sentences.en: soon became much more.
sentences.zh: 很快就演变成了更多东西。

sentences.en: The statue set off a 50-year battle about class,
sentences.zh: 这座雕像引发了一场长达50年的关于阶级、

sentences.en: public space,
sentences.zh: 公共空间，

sentences.en: and what it means for a single piece of art to represent an entire city.
sentences.zh: 以及一件艺术品代表整座城市意味着什么的争论。

sentences.en: In the way that great boxers aren't born as indomitable fortresses of muscle,
sentences.zh: 就像伟大的拳击手并非生来就是不可战胜的肌肉堡垒一样，

sentences.en: the Rocky statue began its life not as an important public sculpture,
sentences.zh: 洛奇雕像的生命起点并非作为重要的公共雕塑，

sentences.en: but a common movie prop.
sentences.zh: 而是一个普通的电影道具。

sentences.en: Stallone had the statue built in 1980.
sentences.zh: 史泰龙在1980年建造了这座雕像。

sentences.en: Originally, it was for a scene in Rocky III in which a fictional mayor,
sentences.zh: 最初，它是为了《洛奇3》中的一个场景，片中一位虚构的市长，

sentences.en: standing next to the statue at the top of the museum's steps,
sentences.zh: 站在博物馆台阶顶端的雕像旁，

sentences.en: dedicates it to the city of Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 将其献给费城市。

sentences.en: It is with tremendous honor that we present this memorial,
sentences.zh: 我们怀着无比崇高的敬意献上这座纪念碑，

sentences.en: which will stand always as a celebration to the indomitable spirit of man.
sentences.zh: 它将永远作为对人类不屈精神的颂歌而矗立。

sentences.en: Philadelphia salutes its favorite son, Rocky Balboa.
sentences.zh: 费城向其最钟爱的儿子洛奇·巴尔博亚致敬。

sentences.en: But instead of getting the art department to make this prop out of painted plastic and foam,
sentences.zh: 但史泰龙没有让艺术部门用彩绘塑料和泡沫制作这个道具，

sentences.en: Stallone paid $53,000 to an artist named A.
sentences.zh: 而是支付了53,000美元给一位名叫A.

sentences.en: Thomas Schaumburg to cast the statue in bronze.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·绍姆堡的艺术家，将雕像铸造成青铜材质。

sentences.en: It is really significant that he chose to have this be made of fine art materials,
sentences.zh: 他选择用纯艺术材料来制作这一点非常重要，

sentences.en: and not just stuff that would be thrown into the trash bin at the end of the film shoot.
sentences.zh: 而不是仅仅用那些在电影拍摄结束后就会被扔进垃圾桶的东西。

sentences.en: Stallone once called Rocky a, quote, euphemism for the city of Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 史泰龙曾称洛奇是“费城市的一个委婉说法”。

sentences.en: Some have speculated that he had always wanted the statue to be a permanent piece of public art there.
sentences.zh: 有人推测他一直希望这座雕像能成为那里永久的公共艺术品。

sentences.en: Stallone went to high school in Philly,
sentences.zh: 史泰龙在费城读过高中，

sentences.en: and because of his and the statue's connection to the city, he made an offer.
sentences.zh: 由于他和雕像与这座城市的联系，他提出了一个提议。

sentences.en: He said that after the Rocky III film shoot,
sentences.zh: 他说在《洛奇3》拍摄结束后，

sentences.en: he wanted to donate the 1,800-pound statue to Philadelphia
sentences.zh: 他想把这座1800磅重的雕像捐赠给费城，

sentences.en: to stand permanently at the top of the museum's steps.
sentences.zh: 让它永久地矗立在博物馆台阶的顶端。

sentences.en: But almost as soon as Stallone announced his plans, there were haters.
sentences.zh: 但史泰龙宣布计划后不久，就出现了反对者。

sentences.en: Critics who didn't want the statue anywhere near the Philadelphia Museum of Art.
sentences.zh: 那些不希望雕像出现在费城艺术博物馆附近的评论家们。

sentences.en: Some refused to indulge what they saw as just an ego trip for Stallone.
sentences.zh: 有些人拒绝纵容他们眼中史泰龙的自我膨胀。

sentences.en: Others said it was simply an ad for his filMs.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则说这纯粹是为他的电影做广告。

sentences.en: But the strongest opposition came from the leadership at the museum.
sentences.zh: 但最强烈的反对来自博物馆的领导层。

sentences.en: Their beef with the statue emerged from a much larger concern.
sentences.zh: 他们对雕像的不满源于一个更大的担忧。

sentences.en: At the time, Philly's influential art patrons and tastemakers were trying to figure out
sentences.zh: 当时，费城有影响力的艺术赞助人和品味制定者们正试图找出，

sentences.en: how to return Philly to its former glory as a hub of national culture.
sentences.zh: 如何让费城重现昔日作为国家文化中心的辉煌。

sentences.en: Philly was hot back in the day.
sentences.zh: 费城过去曾很风光。

sentences.en: I mean, like, way back in the day.
sentences.zh: 我是说，很久以前。

sentences.en: Like, 1776 back.
sentences.zh: 比如1776年的时候。

sentences.en: When Philadelphia was at the center of the nation's founding.
sentences.zh: 那时费城处于国家建立的中心。

sentences.en: But by the early 20th century, that shine had seriously faded.
sentences.zh: 但到了20世纪初，那种光彩已经严重褪色。

sentences.en: Philly looked more like your typical East Coast American city.
sentences.zh: 费城看起来更像是一个典型的美国东海岸城市。

sentences.en: And by the time of the bicentennial, so 1976, Philadelphia had a reputation as a city that
sentences.zh: 到了建国两百周年纪念时，也就是1976年，费城被认为是一个，

sentences.en: just couldn't get a break.
sentences.zh: 总是时运不济的城市。

sentences.en: There was a crumbling urban infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 城市基础设施破败不堪。

sentences.en: There was a lot of corruption in local politics.
sentences.zh: 地方政治中存在大量腐败。

sentences.en: In the nostalgia stirred up by that bicentennial, the 1980s art crowd were dreaming of ways to remake Philly as a grand cultural metropolis.
sentences.zh: 在两百周年纪念激起的怀旧情绪中，80年代的艺术界人士梦想着将费城重塑为宏伟的文化大都市。

sentences.en: They aspired for the city to again become, as a famous architect once called it, the Athens of the Western world.
sentences.zh: 他们渴望这座城市能再次成为一位著名建筑师所称的“西方世界的雅典”。

sentences.en: A city that would boast one of the nation's premier art scenes.
sentences.zh: 一个以拥有全国首屈一指的艺术景观而自豪的城市。

sentences.en: This art crowd had invested a lot in the city's preeminent museum.
sentences.zh: 这些艺术界人士在城市最杰出的博物馆上投入了大量资金。

sentences.en: They didn't think this nine foot tall boxer with shredded abs was going to push Philly toward that dream.
sentences.zh: 他们不认为这个拥有健硕腹肌、九英尺高的拳击手能推动费城实现那个梦想。

sentences.en: They were inclined to tell Stallone, thanks for the gift, but we will decide where it goes.
sentences.zh: 他们倾向于告诉史泰龙：谢谢你的礼物，但我们会决定它放在哪里。

sentences.en: By the way, it won't be anywhere near the museum.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，它不会出现在博物馆附近的任何地方。

sentences.en: But that wasn't actually up to the museum.
sentences.zh: 但这实际上并不由博物馆说了算。

sentences.en: Instead, that decision fell to a couple of city commissions, which voted on the selection and placement of public art around the museum.
sentences.zh: 相反，这个决定权落在了几个城市委员会手中，它们对博物馆周围公共艺术的选择和安置进行投票。

sentences.en: One of those agencies was an eight-member group simply called the Art Commission.
sentences.zh: 其中一个机构是一个由八名成员组成的团体，简称为艺术委员会。

sentences.en: And before they even met to place their votes on where the statue could live, things weren't looking good for Rocky.
sentences.zh: 在他们开会投票决定雕像的安放地点之前，洛奇的情况就不太妙了。

sentences.en: The president of the commission was a wealthy art patron named F.
sentences.zh: 委员会主席是一位名叫F.

sentences.en: Eugene Dixon Jr.
sentences.zh: 尤金·迪克森二世的富有艺术赞助人。

sentences.en: His friends called him Fitz.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友们叫他菲茨。

sentences.en: He'd invested a lot of money in Philly's art sector.
sentences.zh: 他在费城的艺术领域投入了大量资金。

sentences.en: And when he got word of Stallone's gift, he said it would be fine for the statue to stand temporarily on the steps while Stallone promoted Rocky III.
sentences.zh: 当他得知史泰龙的礼物时，他说雕像在史泰龙宣传《洛奇3》期间暂时放在台阶上是可以的。

sentences.en: But in a letter to a colleague, he added,
sentences.zh: 但在给同事的一封信中，他补充道，

sentences.en: If, however, this statue is to be placed somewhere in the courtyard on a permanent basis,
sentences.zh: “然而，如果这座雕像要永久地放置在庭院的某个地方，

sentences.en: I hope you are jesting.
sentences.zh: 我希望你是在开玩笑。”

sentences.en: That's not Fitz.
sentences.zh: 那不是菲茨。

sentences.en: That's writer Mark Bowden.
sentences.zh: 那是作家马克·鲍登。

sentences.en: He signed the letter with best regards, as always.
sentences.zh: 他信末的落款是“一如既往，致以最诚挚的问候”。

sentences.en: Sincerely yours, Fitz.
sentences.zh: “你真诚的，菲茨”。

sentences.en: I just picture him in his mahogany-lined library out on the farm in Montgomery County.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中浮现出他在蒙哥马利县农场那间红木镶板书房里的样子。

sentences.en: I'm just like, who are they kidding?
sentences.zh: 我心想，他们到底在糊弄谁呢？

sentences.en: Mark is the author of numerous acclaimed and best-selling books, including Black Hawk Down and Killing Pablo.
sentences.zh: 马克是许多广受好评的畅销书的作者，包括《黑鹰坠落》和《杀死巴勃罗》。

sentences.en: At the time, he was a staff writer for the Philadelphia Inquirer's Sunday magazine.
sentences.zh: 当时，他是《费城问询报》周日杂志的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: And he covered the Rocky statue gift.
sentences.zh: 他报道了洛奇雕像的捐赠事件。

sentences.en: I was intrigued by the sort of collision between what's popular and what's regarded as serious art.
sentences.zh: 我对大众流行事物与被视为严肃艺术的事物之间的碰撞很感兴趣。

sentences.en: As Mark worked on the story, he discovered the museum crowd bristled even at the use of the term art when discussing the Rocky statue.
sentences.zh: 当马克撰写这篇报道时，他发现博物馆界的人士甚至对在讨论洛奇雕像时使用“艺术”一词都感到反感。

sentences.en: Their position?
sentences.zh: 他们的立场是？

sentences.en: We're not even talking about, really, a work of art.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的根本不是一件艺术品。

sentences.en: We're talking about a movie prop.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是一个电影道具。

sentences.en: This raised a question for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我提出了一个问题。

sentences.en: As art goes, could one deign to call the Rocky statue an aesthetically good sculpture?
sentences.zh: 作为艺术品，人们敢称洛奇雕像为一件审美上优秀的雕塑吗？

sentences.en: Like, was it beautifully crafted?
sentences.zh: 比如，它制作精美吗？

sentences.en: How did it stack up, pound for pound, against other famous sculptures?
sentences.zh: 它与其他著名雕塑相比，水平如何？

sentences.en: I brought my questions to Laura Holzman.
sentences.zh: 我带着我的问题去请教了劳拉·霍尔兹曼。

sentences.en: Is it a good statue?
sentences.zh: 它是一座好雕像吗？

sentences.en: That's such a hard question to answer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很难回答的问题。

sentences.en: What makes anything a good statue?
sentences.zh: 什么才算是一座好雕像呢？

sentences.en: She did her best to avoid it.
sentences.zh: 她尽力回避这个问题。

sentences.en: I can say that it means something very important to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我可以肯定地说，它对很多人来说意义重大。

sentences.en: Went to great lengths to preface her answer.
sentences.zh: 她费尽心思地为自己的回答做铺垫。

sentences.en: I mean no offense to the people who worked really, really hard to produce it, maintain it, install it.
sentences.zh: 我无意冒犯那些为制作、维护和安装它而付出巨大努力的人们。

sentences.en: Then ultimately gave in.
sentences.zh: 但最终还是妥协了。

sentences.en: Yeah, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: I will say, on aesthetic terms, the Rocky statue doesn't quite do it for me.
sentences.zh: 我会说，从审美角度来看，洛奇雕像并不太合我的胃口。

sentences.en: He's kind of awkward looking.
sentences.zh: 它看起来有点别扭。

sentences.en: Other art historians and critics I spoke to weren't so diplomatic.
sentences.zh: 我采访的其他艺术史学家和评论家就没有那么委婉了。

sentences.en: One called it, quote, a pretty limp piece of sculpture, not a powerful work of art, and a very superficial look at the human body.
sentences.zh: 有人称它为“一件相当无力的雕塑作品，不是一件有力的艺术品，而且对人体的观察非常肤浅”。

sentences.en: Another praised Rocky's armpit hair, to the exclusion of every other detail in the statue.
sentences.zh: 另一个人则称赞了洛奇的腋毛，而忽略了雕像的所有其他细节。

sentences.en: So it's not surprising that in the winter of 1980, the Art Commission voted 6-2 to reject the permanent placement of the statue on the museum's steps.
sentences.zh: 所以，1980年冬天，艺术委员会以6比2的投票结果拒绝将雕像永久放置在博物馆台阶上，这并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Stallone could put it there to film his movie, but after Rocky III wrapped, the commission would choose a different place to park his gift to the city.
sentences.zh: 史泰龙可以把它放在那里拍摄电影，但在《洛奇3》拍摄结束后，委员会会选择其他地方来安放他送给城市的礼物。

sentences.en: And if you're wondering, the remaining two votes were to bar the statue from the steps entirely.
sentences.zh: 如果你好奇的话，剩下的两票是要求完全禁止雕像出现在台阶上。

sentences.en: So the statue stood for a few days at the top of the museum's steps while they filmed Rocky III.
sentences.zh: 所以雕像在博物馆台阶顶端站了几天，拍摄了《洛奇3》。

sentences.en: Then it was packed up and shipped all the way to L.A., where some might say a movie prop belongs.
sentences.zh: 然后它被打包运往洛杉矶，有人可能会说，那才是电影道具该去的地方。

sentences.en: But the fight was far from over, because while some wealthy, influential art patrons, some might call snobs, did not appreciate the statue, a lot of other Philadelphians did.
sentences.zh: 但这场斗争远未结束，因为虽然一些富有、有影响力的艺术赞助人——有人可能会称他们为势利小人——并不欣赏这座雕像，但许多其他费城人却很喜欢。

sentences.en: To them, the idea of a local guy who fought his way to the top through pure grit and determination, no trust fund needed, this was the real Philadelphia,
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，一个靠纯粹的毅力和决心一路拼搏到顶峰的本地小伙子，不需要信托基金，这才是真正的费城，

sentences.en: working class Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 蓝领阶层的费城。

sentences.en: So, at the same time Stallone's team was pressing the city to put the statue back in Philly, a similar push came from a local truck driver named Art Gorman.
sentences.zh: 因此，在史泰龙团队向市政府施压要求将雕像放回费城的同时，一位名叫阿特·戈尔曼的当地卡车司机也发起了类似的推动。

sentences.en: He was one of the statue's biggest champions.
sentences.zh: 他是这座雕像最大的支持者之一。

sentences.en: Here's Mark Bowden again.
sentences.zh: 马克·鲍登又来了。

sentences.en: Art, you know, was just a huge enthusiast of the movie Rocky, and hence Sylvester Stallone.
sentences.zh: 阿特，你知道，只是电影《洛奇》的超级粉丝，因此也是西尔维斯特·史泰龙的粉丝。

sentences.en: And he is a sort of a salt-of-the-earth Philly guy from a blue-collar neighborhood who feels like,
sentences.zh: 他是一个来自蓝领社区、脚踏实地的费城人，他觉得，

sentences.en: who are these snooty guardians of good taste to be telling us what we should be able to see on the steps of the Philadelphia Art Museum?
sentences.zh: 这些自命不凡的品味守护者凭什么告诉我们应该在费城艺术博物馆的台阶上看到什么？

sentences.en: We want it there.
sentences.zh: 我们就要它放在那里。

sentences.en: In late 1980, Gorman drafted a petition in support of bringing the statue from L.A.
sentences.zh: 1980年年底，戈尔曼起草了一份请愿书，支持将这座雕像从洛杉矶

sentences.en: back to Philly permanently.
sentences.zh: 永久迁回费城。

sentences.en: I do think we should note it was written entirely in capital letters.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为我们应该注意到，这份请愿书全文都是用大写字母书写的。

sentences.en: Mark read me some of the petition.
sentences.zh: 马克给我读了一些请愿书的内容。

sentences.en: Rocky statue should be back in Philly, remember?
sentences.zh: 洛奇雕像应该回到费城，还记得吗？

sentences.en: Rocky won when you and the kids went to the movie.
sentences.zh: 当你和孩子们去看电影时，洛奇赢了。

sentences.en: What did they and yourself feel?
sentences.zh: 你们和你自己有什么感受？

sentences.en: Seeing Philly on the screen instead of New York or San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 在银幕上看到费城，而不是纽约或旧金山。

sentences.en: Pretty good.
sentences.zh: 感觉相当不错。

sentences.en: Ha!
sentences.zh: 哈！

sentences.en: Why don't you voice your opinion if you feel that the statue should be back in Philly?
sentences.zh: 既然你觉得雕像应该回到费城，为什么不表达你的意见呢？

sentences.en: Gorman hit the streets collecting thousands of signatures from regular Philadelphians.
sentences.zh: 戈尔曼走上街头，从普通费城人那里收集了数千个签名。

sentences.en: This impassioned 33-year-old door-knocking around Philly, fighting to bring back the Rocky statue, drummed up a bunch of media coverage.
sentences.zh: 这位充满激情的33岁年轻人，在费城挨家挨户敲门，为争取洛奇雕像回归而奔走，引起了媒体的大量关注。

sentences.en: Petitions are being collected around Philadelphia asking for the return of Rocky.
sentences.zh: 费城各地正在收集请愿书，要求洛奇回归。

sentences.en: It seems like the story gets told in a way that pits blue-collar Philadelphia against elitist high-culture Philadelphia, this narrative of, you know, slobs versus snobs.
sentences.zh: 这个故事似乎总是以一种将蓝领费城与精英高雅文化费城对立起来的方式讲述，也就是所谓的“粗人与势利眼”的叙事。

sentences.en: Still, it was the snobs who got to vote on the matter.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，最终有权投票决定此事的还是那些势利眼。

sentences.en: And the petition didn't change their basic stance.
sentences.zh: 而且请愿书并没有改变他们的基本立场。

sentences.en: Rocky III was about to come out in theaters.
sentences.zh: 《洛奇3》即将上映。

sentences.en: So the Art Commission said, fine, the statue could come back to the museum steps, but only for the premiere.
sentences.zh: 所以艺术委员会说，好吧，雕像可以回到博物馆台阶上，但仅限于首映式期间。

sentences.en: As soon as that was over, Stallone's gift would have to be taken off the stairs.
sentences.zh: 一旦首映结束，史泰龙的这份礼物就必须从台阶上移走。

sentences.en: Rocky III opened in May 1982.
sentences.zh: 《洛奇3》于1982年5月上映。

sentences.en: Philly's celebration featuring the Rocky statue came and went.
sentences.zh: 费城以洛奇雕像为特色的庆祝活动如期举行，随后结束。

sentences.en: But the production company kind of just left it there.
sentences.zh: 但制作公司就那样把它留在了那里。

sentences.en: And the city won't pay to have it removed.
sentences.zh: 而市政府不愿支付拆除费用。

sentences.en: So the museum has to take care of it.
sentences.zh: 所以博物馆不得不负责处理它。

sentences.en: It was several months before movers finally came to haul the statue away.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，搬运工才终于来把雕像拖走。

sentences.en: But when they got to the museum, they had one more obstacle to deal with.
sentences.zh: 但当他们到达博物馆时，他们还要面对最后一个障碍。

sentences.en: The statue was bolted to the pavement with steel rods that went several feet into the ground.
sentences.zh: 雕像用钢筋固定在路面上，钢筋深入地下几英尺。

sentences.en: It was as if the movie producers meant for it to stay there forever.
sentences.zh: 就好像电影制片人打算让它永远留在那里一样。

sentences.en: But the statue was finally pried loose and hauled five miles away to its new home in South Philly
sentences.zh: 但雕像最终还是被撬松，并被拖运了五英里，到了它在南费城的新家——

sentences.en: at the Spectrum Sports Arena where other statues of athletes stood.
sentences.zh: 光谱体育馆，那里还矗立着其他运动员的雕像。

sentences.en: And to most, it seemed like the fight was over.
sentences.zh: 对大多数人来说，这场斗争似乎结束了。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's Rocky.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，那是洛奇。

sentences.en: The fight over the statue kept going.
sentences.zh: 关于雕像的争斗还在继续。

sentences.en: Partly because the movie franchise just kept going.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是电影系列一直在继续。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Big reveal.
sentences.zh: 大揭秘。

sentences.en: The Rocky series did not end up being a trilogy.
sentences.zh: 《洛奇》系列最终并没有止步于三部曲。

sentences.en: There was another.
sentences.zh: 还有一部。

sentences.en: Rocky IV is one of the big hits of the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 《洛奇4》是假日季的热门大片之一。

sentences.en: And another.
sentences.zh: 还有一部。

sentences.en: The Rocky production crew spent two months in Philadelphia filming Rocky V.
sentences.zh: 《洛奇》摄制组在费城花了两个月时间拍摄《洛奇5》。

sentences.en: As he cranked out sequels, Stallone asked the Art Commission repeatedly
sentences.zh: 随着续集的不断推出，史泰龙多次请求艺术委员会

sentences.en: to move the statue from the Spectrum to the museum for good.
sentences.zh: 将雕像从光谱体育馆永久移回博物馆。

sentences.en: And each time, the commission said no.
sentences.zh: 但每一次，委员会都拒绝了。

sentences.en: And that's how it went for 25 years.
sentences.zh: 这就是过去25年的情况。

sentences.en: Rocky punched.
sentences.zh: 洛奇出拳。

sentences.en: The museum counterpunched.
sentences.zh: 博物馆反击。

sentences.en: Then, in 2006, Rocky got his best opportunity yet.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2006年，洛奇迎来了他迄今为止最好的机会。

sentences.en: Don Street, Philly's mayor at the time, had launched several projects to revitalize public
sentences.zh: 时任费城市长唐·斯特里特启动了几个项目，旨在振兴全市的公共

sentences.en: spaces all over the city.
sentences.zh: 空间。

sentences.en: So the topic of what public art would be displayed in those spaces had some traction.
sentences.zh: 因此，关于在这些空间展示什么公共艺术的话题得到了一些支持。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Stallone was preparing to release Rocky Balboa, the first Rocky movie in 16 years.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，史泰龙正准备发行《洛奇：勇者无惧》，这是16年来的第一部洛奇电影。

sentences.en: Philly usually hosted big Rocky premiere parties, which helped promote the movies and the city.
sentences.zh: 费城通常会举办盛大的洛奇首映派对，这有助于宣传电影和城市。

sentences.en: At that point, the Rocky statue was in storage while the city built a new sports complex.
sentences.zh: 当时，由于城市正在建设新的体育综合体，洛奇雕像被存放在仓库里。

sentences.en: This seemed like the perfect moment for it to reemerge as a piece of public art and to
sentences.zh: 这似乎是它作为公共艺术品重现，并借此

sentences.en: use it to celebrate the new film.
sentences.zh: 庆祝新电影上映的绝佳时机。

sentences.en: That's when a lawyer named Jimmy Benz decided to make a very important phone call.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，一位名叫吉米·本茨的律师决定打一个非常重要的电话。

sentences.en: Jimmy was a friend of Sylvester Stallone.
sentences.zh: 吉米是西尔维斯特·史泰龙的朋友。

sentences.en: He appeared in one of the Rocky sequels and had a reputation as a Philly power broker.
sentences.zh: 他曾在一部洛奇续集中露面，在费城以人脉广博著称。

sentences.en: I got Jimmy on the phone and he told me how he asked Stallone if he wanted some help getting
sentences.zh: 我给吉米打了电话，他告诉我他是如何问史泰龙是否需要帮助把

sentences.en: the statue to the museum.
sentences.zh: 雕像弄回博物馆的。

sentences.en: Stallone said, yeah.
sentences.zh: 史泰龙说，好啊。

sentences.en: So Jimmy called up the mayor and told him that he, Jimmy, would like the statue back at
sentences.zh: 于是吉米给市长打了电话，告诉他，他，也就是吉米，希望雕像回到

sentences.en: the museum.
sentences.zh: 博物馆。

sentences.en: Here's what he said.
sentences.zh: 他是这么说的。

sentences.en: He said, you know, those people go crazy.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，那些人疯了。

sentences.en: Those people meaning the trustees of the museum.
sentences.zh: 那些人指的是博物馆的理事们。

sentences.en: And I said to him, well, let me ask you a question.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，好吧，让我问你个问题。

sentences.en: I said, do those people invite you over to their house on Sunday afternoon for cocktails?
sentences.zh: 我说，那些人周日下午会邀请你去他们家喝鸡尾酒吗？

sentences.en: And he laughed and he said, no.
sentences.zh: 他笑了笑说，没有。

sentences.en: And I said, well, f*** them.
sentences.zh: 我说，那去他妈的。

sentences.en: And he said, OK, f*** them.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，去他妈的。

sentences.en: With the mayor's support, the idea of placing the statue at the museum finally started gaining
sentences.zh: 在市长的支持下，将雕像安置在博物馆的想法终于开始获得

sentences.en: real momentum.
sentences.zh: 真正的推动力。

sentences.en: Even the Philadelphia Museum of Art began to bend.
sentences.zh: 连费城艺术博物馆也开始妥协了。

sentences.en: The mayor's office was able to persuade the museum to consider Stallone's vision.
sentences.zh: 市长办公室成功说服了博物馆考虑史泰龙的愿景。

sentences.en: The museum and the mayor's office began to hash out a potential compromise.
sentences.zh: 博物馆和市长办公室开始商讨一个潜在的折中方案。

sentences.en: The statue would move out of storage and back to the museum permanently.
sentences.zh: 雕像将从仓库移出，永久回到博物馆。

sentences.en: However, not at the top of the steps, but at the bottom and a little to the side.
sentences.zh: 不过，不是在台阶顶部，而是在底部，稍微偏向一侧。

sentences.en: At long last, after nearly a quarter century of petitioning, it seemed like Stallone was about
sentences.zh: 终于，经过近四分之一个世纪的请愿，史泰龙似乎即将

sentences.en: to make his dream come true.
sentences.zh: 实现他的梦想。

sentences.en: The only hurdle left was the Art Commission, because they were the ones who still had the
sentences.zh: 剩下的唯一障碍是艺术委员会，因为他们仍然对雕像的去向拥有

sentences.en: final vote on where the statue would go.
sentences.zh: 最终投票权。

sentences.en: When this fight started, they were the statue haters.
sentences.zh: 当这场斗争开始时，他们是雕像的反对者。

sentences.en: But this time, it seemed like they might play ball.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，他们似乎愿意配合了。

sentences.en: So in May of 2006, the Philadelphia Art Commission announces that the statue might be relocated to
sentences.zh: 于是，在2006年5月，费城艺术委员会宣布雕像可能会被重新安置到

sentences.en: the museum.
sentences.zh: 博物馆。

sentences.en: And a whole additional wave of public debate comes out of that.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是新一轮的公众辩论。

sentences.en: That debate involved not just commission members, but all sorts of gatekeepers who were weighing
sentences.zh: 这场辩论不仅涉及委员会成员，还有各种各样的把关人，他们都在权衡

sentences.en: in on the statue's artistic merit and where to put it.
sentences.zh: 雕像的艺术价值以及放置的位置。

sentences.en: One city official named Harris Baum went on a local NPR call-in show to express his desire
sentences.zh: 一位名叫哈里斯·鲍姆的市政官员参加了当地NPR的电话连线节目，表达了他希望

sentences.en: to keep the statue far away from the museum.
sentences.zh: 让雕像远离博物馆的愿望。

sentences.en: He said it clashed with the commission's grand vision for the Benjamin Franklin Parkway, where
sentences.zh: 他说，这与委员会对本杰明·富兰克林大道（博物馆所在地）的宏伟愿景相冲突。

sentences.en: the museum sits.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图将这条大道发展成类似于巴黎香榭丽舍大街那样的地方。

sentences.en: We're trying to develop the parkway to become a Champs-Élysées, similar to what they have in Paris.
sentences.zh: 我们希望在艺术博物馆周围开发更多的艺术品。

sentences.en: And we want to develop more art around the art museum as such.
sentences.zh: 但那件东西不是艺术品。

sentences.en: But that is not a piece of art.
sentences.zh: 但鲍姆得到的反应与80年代可能出现的情况不同。

sentences.en: But the response Baum got wasn't the same as it might have been back in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 现在，听众们不想被卷入关于艺术的辩论中。

sentences.en: Now, listeners didn't want to get pulled into a debate about art.
sentences.zh: 鲍姆是在打一场过时的仗。

sentences.en: Baum was fighting an old fight.
sentences.zh: 对于打进电话的听众来说，这关乎洛奇如何代表他们。

sentences.en: For the listeners who called in, it was about how Rocky represented them.
sentences.zh: 你好，朱迪。

sentences.en: Hi, Judy.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 这是你的《广播时间》节目。

sentences.en: Your Radio Times.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它放在台阶顶上，不是吗？

sentences.en: You can put me at the top of the steps, can't it?
sentences.zh: 那座雕像是一个标志。

sentences.en: That statue is an icon.
sentences.zh: 它是我们小镇蓝领精神的象征。

sentences.en: It's an image of the blue-collar spirit of our town.
sentences.zh: 它展示了我们在费城所代表的一切。

sentences.en: It illustrates what we are all about in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 让我请兰斯代尔的杰克加入我们。

sentences.en: Let me get Jack from Lansdale to join us.
sentences.zh: 你好，杰克。

sentences.en: Hi, Jack.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 你在直播中。

sentences.en: You're on the air.
sentences.zh: 我只是想说，理想情况下，我希望能看到它在台阶顶上。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say, ideally, I'd like to see it at the top of the steps.
sentences.zh: 但一群自命不凡的“扑粉假发”不会让这种事发生。

sentences.en: But a bunch of pompous powdered wigs aren't going to let that happen.
sentences.zh: 好吧，就一个简单的问题。

sentences.en: Well, just one quick question.
sentences.zh: 你是说哈里斯·鲍姆自命不凡吗？

sentences.en: I mean, are you calling Harris Baum pompous?
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 他刚才表现出的那种势利，简直是，绝对是侮辱人。

sentences.en: The snobbery that he was exuding earlier, it's just, it's absolutely insulting.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，先生。

sentences.en: Pardon me, sir.
sentences.zh: 但也许费城人喜欢它现在的位置。

sentences.en: But maybe Philadelphia likes it where it is.
sentences.zh: 凭什么由你来决定费城应该是什么样子？

sentences.en: Why do you get to decide what Philadelphia looks like?
sentences.zh: 你听得出来。

sentences.en: You can hear it.
sentences.zh: 费城人已经对这座雕像产生了忠诚感。

sentences.en: Philadelphians had developed a loyalty to the statue.
sentences.zh: 就像他们在保护自己街坊里的一个伙计一样。

sentences.en: It's like they were defending a guy from their own neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 2006年9月6日，艺术委员会再次投票，决定洛奇雕像是否能

sentences.en: On September 6, 2006, the Art Commission voted, again, on whether or not the Rocky statue could
sentences.zh: 最终留在博物馆台阶旁。

sentences.en: finally live beside the museum's steps.
sentences.zh: 那次会议的纪要反映出他们的想法发生了明显的转变。

sentences.en: And the minutes from that meeting reflect a clear shift in their thinking.
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 大多数成员认为，雕像的标志性象征意义已经为它赢得了在城市身份中的一席之地。

sentences.en: Most members felt that the statue's iconic symbolism has won it a place in the city's identity.
sentences.zh: 以6票对2票的结果，艺术委员会最终批准了将洛奇雕像安装在

sentences.en: By a vote of 6-2, the Art Commission finally approved plans to install the Rocky statue at
sentences.zh: 博物馆的计划。

sentences.en: the museum.
sentences.zh: 那些势利眼妥协了。

sentences.en: The snobs had given in.
sentences.zh: 不到一周后，市政府在博物馆台阶底部、稍微偏向一侧的新家揭幕了这座雕像。

sentences.en: Less than a week later, the city unveiled the statue in its new home, at the base of
sentences.zh: 所以，这是费城KYW电视台的一段视频。

sentences.en: the museum's steps, and a little to the side.
sentences.zh: 当音乐响起，幕布落下，一座八英尺半高的

sentences.en: So, this is a clip from KYW-TV in Philly.
sentences.zh: 青铜洛奇雕像揭幕时，你可以听到观众的欢呼声。

sentences.en: And you hear the audience roar when the music swells and the curtain drops and an eight-and-a-half-foot
sentences.zh: 史泰龙走到雕像前，以一种孩子气的方式惊叹不已。

sentences.en: bronze Rocky is unveiled.
sentences.zh: 就像是，这一切到底是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Stallone walks up to the statue and kind of marvels at it in this boyish way.
sentences.zh: 他抬起手，赞赏地拍了拍雕像坚如磐石的腹肌。

sentences.en: Like, how did this finally happen?
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，我觉得这一切出奇地感人。

sentences.en: He lifts his hand and pats the statue admiringly on its rock-hard abs.
sentences.zh: 我不敢相信你们竟然允许我以这种方式走进你们的生活，并拥有这种

sentences.en: I have to say, I found the whole thing oddly touching.
sentences.zh: 不可思议的——这对我来说简直是不可思议，这种事竟然会发生。

sentences.en: I can't believe you've allowed me to come into your lives in such a way and have this
sentences.zh: 我问劳拉·哈尔斯曼，她是否认为这是博物馆和艺术委员会在26年的抵制后

sentences.en: incredible—this is actually mind-bending to me that this could happen.
sentences.zh: 终于接纳了洛奇雕像。

sentences.en: I asked Laura Halsman if she thinks this was the museum and the Art Commission finally embracing
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种接纳。

sentences.en: the Rocky statue after 26 years of resistance.
sentences.zh: 到了2006年，它不仅仅是洛奇电影的广告。

sentences.en: I think it's an acceptance.
sentences.zh: 它成为了费城、费城的坚韧与毅力，以及费城名声的广告，

sentences.en: By 2006, it doesn't just work as an advertisement for the Rocky movies.
sentences.zh: 这种名声不仅来自纯艺术，也来自流行文化。

sentences.en: It works as an advertisement for Philadelphia and Philadelphia's grit and resilience and Philadelphia's
sentences.zh: 费城的名声，不仅来自纯艺术，也来自流行文化。

sentences.en: fame, not just from fine art, but also from pop culture.
sentences.zh: 费城的名声，不仅来自纯艺术，也来自流行文化。

sentences.en: This acceptance marked a new era in the statue's life.
sentences.zh: 这次认可标志着这座雕像的生命进入了一个新时代。

sentences.en: What you start to see is an understanding that this is becoming a fixture in the city's
sentences.zh: 你开始意识到，人们逐渐将它视为这座城市

sentences.en: landscape.
sentences.zh: 景观中不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: It's emerging as a monument, and it's being treated as that.
sentences.zh: 它正在成为一座纪念碑，并被当作纪念碑来对待。

sentences.en: Paul Farber directs Monument Lab, a nonprofit that studies and advises on monuments around
sentences.zh: 保罗·法伯（Paul Farber）是“纪念碑实验室”（Monument Lab）的负责人，这是一个研究并为全国各地纪念碑提供建议的非营利组织。

sentences.en: the country.
sentences.zh: 当它在2006年回到艺术博物馆，回到台阶底部时，我认为它在城市中被越来越多地视为一座公认的纪念碑。

sentences.en: When it comes back to the art museum, to the base of the steps in 2006, I think it is seen
sentences.zh: 当它在2006年回到艺术博物馆，回到台阶底部时，我认为它在城市中被越来越多地视为一座公认的纪念碑。

sentences.en: more and more as an accepted monument in the city.
sentences.zh: 当它在2006年回到艺术博物馆，回到台阶底部时，我认为它在城市中被越来越多地视为一座公认的纪念碑。

sentences.en: The bureaucracy of the city is treating it as something that's going to stay.
sentences.zh: 市政府的官僚机构正把它当作一个会长期存在的事物来对待。

sentences.en: Once Rocky was installed, the city leaned fully into its status as a Philadelphia monument.
sentences.zh: 洛奇雕像一旦安装完毕，这座城市就完全认可了它作为费城纪念碑的地位。

sentences.en: Lights were added to illuminate the statue for night visitors.
sentences.zh: 人们还加装了灯光，以便在夜间照亮这座雕像，供游客参观。

sentences.en: It was hoisted up onto a brand new foot and a half tall granite pedestal.
sentences.zh: 它被吊装到了一个全新的、一英尺半高的花岗岩基座上。

sentences.en: This kind of publicly ratified monument is different from a statue that starts out as a monument.
sentences.zh: 这种经过公众认可的纪念碑，与那种一开始就作为纪念碑而建造的雕像有所不同。

sentences.en: The art historian Alois Regal once talked about the distinction between what he called deliberate
sentences.zh: 艺术史学家阿洛伊斯·里格尔（Alois Riegl）曾谈到过他所谓的刻意纪念碑

sentences.en: monuments and unintentional ones.
sentences.zh: 与无意纪念碑之间的区别。

sentences.en: The deliberate monuments are the dudes on horses, sculptures made explicitly to commemorate a
sentences.zh: 刻意纪念碑是指那些骑马的英雄雕像，是为了纪念某个人或某件事而专门制作的雕塑。

sentences.en: person or an event.
sentences.zh: 刻意纪念碑是指那些骑马的英雄雕像，是为了纪念某个人或某件事而专门制作的雕塑。

sentences.en: An unintentional monument is an object that becomes important to us not for the reasons
sentences.zh: 无意纪念碑是指那些对我们变得重要，但并非因为其最初制作原因的对象。

sentences.en: it was originally made.
sentences.zh: 无意纪念碑是指那些对我们变得重要，但并非因为其最初制作原因的对象。

sentences.en: It becomes meaningful because of how we, the viewers, come to see it.
sentences.zh: 它之所以变得有意义，是因为我们这些观众看待它的方式。

sentences.en: Like an ordinary house that later becomes a landmark or a museum.
sentences.zh: 就像一栋普通的房子后来变成了地标或博物馆一样。

sentences.en: The Rocky statue had undergone this transformation.
sentences.zh: 洛奇雕像就经历了这种转变。

sentences.en: It had transcended the squabbles about art that initially surrounded it and arrived as a full-on
sentences.zh: 它超越了最初围绕它的艺术争论，最终成为了一座名副其实的

sentences.en: monument.
sentences.zh: 纪念碑。

sentences.en: Up on its pedestal, looking over Philadelphia, it seemed like Rocky had at last found its permanent
sentences.zh: 它矗立在基座上，俯瞰着费城，仿佛洛奇终于找到了它永久的

sentences.en: home.
sentences.zh: 家。

sentences.en: But then, about a decade into the statue's residence there, a tragedy more than 500 miles south
sentences.zh: 但就在雕像在那里安家大约十年后，费城以南500多英里处发生的一场悲剧，引发了全国范围内关于种族和纪念碑的清算。

sentences.en: of Philly would spark a reckoning about race and monuments around the country.
sentences.zh: 但就在雕像在那里安家大约十年后，费城以南500多英里处发生的一场悲剧，引发了全国范围内关于种族和纪念碑的清算。

sentences.en: And once again, Rocky was in the middle of a whole new controversy.
sentences.zh: 洛奇再次陷入了一场全新的争议之中。

sentences.en: More of that after the break.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我们将继续探讨。

sentences.en: By 2015, the Rocky statue had been standing beside the Philadelphia Museum of Art for nearly
sentences.zh: 到2015年，洛奇雕像已经在费城艺术博物馆旁矗立了近

sentences.en: 10 years.
It drew locals and tourists who posed and took pictures next to the bronze champ.
sentences.zh: 它吸引了当地人和游客，他们纷纷在铜像冠军身旁摆姿势拍照。

sentences.en: It seemed like the statue could finally settle into its status as a true Philadelphia monument.
sentences.zh: 看起来这座雕像终于可以安稳地保持它作为费城真正纪念碑的地位了。

sentences.en: But then, Rocky got swept up into a different fight.
sentences.zh: 但随后，洛奇被卷入了另一场纷争。

sentences.en: It started in June 2015, when white supremacist Dylan Roof entered a black church in Charleston,
sentences.zh: 这一切始于2015年6月，当时白人至上主义者迪伦·鲁夫（Dylan Roof）进入南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿的一座黑人教堂，

sentences.en: South Carolina, and opened fire.
sentences.zh: 并开枪扫射。

sentences.en: Nine people were killed that day.
sentences.zh: 那天有九人遇害。

sentences.en: Roof's plan was to start a race war.
sentences.zh: 鲁夫的计划是发动一场种族战争。

sentences.en: The mass shooting highlighted issues of white supremacist violence and domestic terrorism in
sentences.zh: 这起大规模枪击事件凸显了美国国内白人至上主义暴力和国内恐怖主义的问题。

sentences.en: the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这起大规模枪击事件凸显了美国国内白人至上主义暴力和国内恐怖主义的问题。

sentences.en: It also stirred up an ongoing conversation around racist symbols, especially monuments.
sentences.zh: 它还激起了关于种族主义符号，尤其是纪念碑的持续讨论。

sentences.en: Here's Paul Farber again from the Monument Lab.
sentences.zh: 再次请出“纪念碑实验室”的保罗·法伯。

sentences.en: At that moment, there is a groundswell around rethinking the monuments that we have inherited
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，人们掀起了一股重新思考我们所继承的纪念碑

sentences.en: and the symbols.
sentences.zh: 和符号的热潮。

sentences.en: We have a monument landscape that has elevated Confederates over civil rights.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有的纪念碑景观将邦联支持者置于民权运动之上。

sentences.en: Around the country, people began questioning flags and statues representing America's racist history.
sentences.zh: 在全国各地，人们开始质疑那些代表美国种族主义历史的旗帜和雕像。

sentences.en: Eventually, that reckoning came to Philly.
sentences.zh: 最终，这场清算来到了费城。

sentences.en: The spotlight fell on a few monuments in particular, including several Christopher Columbus statues,
sentences.zh: 聚光灯落在了几座特定的纪念碑上，包括几座克里斯托弗·哥伦布雕像，

sentences.en: also a statue of former mayor Frank Rizzo, known for violent policing in black communities
sentences.zh: 还有前市长弗兰克·里佐（Frank Rizzo）的雕像，他以在黑人社区的暴力执法

sentences.en: and racially inflammatory rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 和煽动种族情绪的言论而闻名。

sentences.en: And when Paul's organization, Monument Lab, asked Philadelphians about what kinds of monuments
sentences.zh: 当保罗的组织“纪念碑实验室”询问费城人，他们会建造什么样的纪念碑

sentences.en: they would build to reflect their city's visions and values,
sentences.zh: 来反映他们城市的愿景和价值观时，

sentences.en: he heard questions about whether Rocky was a good monument for Philly.
sentences.zh: 他听到了一些关于洛奇是否是费城好纪念碑的质疑。

sentences.en: At that point, like, Rocky isn't in the spotlight, in the heat of a reckoning about monuments,
sentences.zh: 在那时，洛奇虽然没有处于聚光灯下，也没有处于纪念碑清算的风口浪尖，

sentences.en: but the murmurs are there.
sentences.zh: 但已经有了微词。

sentences.en: Some of those murmurs went like this.
sentences.zh: 其中一些微词是这样的：

sentences.en: Rocky's cool, but Philly is a city with a real history of boxing.
sentences.zh: 洛奇很酷，但费城是一座有着真正拳击历史的城市。

sentences.en: And unlike the fictional Italian stallion, most of those real boxers were black,
sentences.zh: 而且与虚构的“意大利种马”不同，那些真正的拳击手大多是黑人，

sentences.en: including Joe Frazier, the one-time heavyweight champion and first to defeat Muhammad Ali
sentences.zh: 包括乔·弗雷泽（Joe Frazier），他曾是重量级冠军，也是第一个击败穆罕默德·阿里的人，

sentences.en: in a fight that over 300 million people watched.
sentences.zh: 那场比赛有超过3亿人观看。

sentences.en: Frazier becomes a kind of beloved hometown hero in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 弗雷泽在费城成为了一种备受爱戴的家乡英雄。

sentences.en: You know, you don't have Rocky Balboa without Joe Frazier.
sentences.zh: 你知道，没有乔·弗雷泽，就不会有洛奇·巴尔博亚。

sentences.en: Paul's referring to the fact that the most famous parts of the training montage in the first Rocky movie,
sentences.zh: 保罗指的是这样一个事实：第一部《洛奇》电影中训练蒙太奇最著名的部分，

sentences.en: running up the museum steps and punching raw meat,
sentences.zh: 跑上博物馆台阶和击打生肉，

sentences.en: those were actually taken from Frazier's real workout routines.
sentences.zh: 实际上都是取自弗雷泽真实的训练日常。

sentences.en: Frazier did get a statue in 2015, but for a lot of Philadelphians,
sentences.zh: 弗雷泽确实在2015年拥有了一座雕像，但对许多费城人来说，

sentences.en: the 12-foot bronze likeness fell short of a fair tribute to a real-life boxing legend,
sentences.zh: 这座12英尺高的铜像不足以公平地致敬这位现实生活中的拳击传奇，

sentences.en: especially compared to the love Rocky had received.
sentences.zh: 尤其是与洛奇所受到的爱戴相比。

sentences.en: We heard that Joe Frazier wasn't getting his due,
sentences.zh: 我们听说乔·弗雷泽没有得到他应有的待遇，

sentences.en: like that there was an opportunity to do right by his legacy.
sentences.zh: 似乎有机会为他的遗产正名。

sentences.en: His image is not emblazoned on tour buses,
sentences.zh: 他的形象没有被印在旅游巴士上，

sentences.en: and the steps that he ran up are called the Rocky steps.
sentences.zh: 而他跑上去的那些台阶却被称为“洛奇台阶”。

sentences.en: That imbalance and the question it raised around race were soon brought into even sharper focus.
sentences.zh: 这种不平衡以及它引发的关于种族的质疑，很快变得更加尖锐。

sentences.en: In the summer of 2020, after the murder of George Floyd,
sentences.zh: 2020年夏天，在乔治·弗洛伊德被谋杀后，

sentences.en: the ongoing fight over America's monuments heated up once again.
sentences.zh: 围绕美国纪念碑的持续斗争再次升温。

sentences.en: Ordinary citizens toppled statues depicting historical figures associated with racist ideas.
sentences.zh: 普通公民推倒了那些描绘与种族主义思想相关的历史人物的雕像。

sentences.en: Five days after Floyd was killed, someone set fire to the Rizzo statue.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伊德被杀五天后，有人放火烧了里佐雕像。

sentences.en: In Marconi Plaza, groups of mostly white residents armed with clubs and guns
sentences.zh: 在马可尼广场（Marconi Plaza），一群主要是白人的居民手持棍棒和枪支，

sentences.en: surrounded a Columbus statue to guard it from being torn down.
sentences.zh: 围住了一座哥伦布雕像，以防它被拆除。

sentences.en: As for Rocky, now that his statue was considered a monument,
sentences.zh: 至于洛奇，既然他的雕像被视为一座纪念碑，

sentences.en: it would have to face the same scrutiny as these other statues.
sentences.zh: 它就必须面对与其他雕像同样的审查。

sentences.en: Here was a tribute to a fictional white movie character
sentences.zh: 这原本是对一个虚构的白人电影角色的致敬，

sentences.en: who many felt had stolen the spotlight from a real hometown black boxing champion.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为他抢走了现实中黑人拳击冠军的风头。

sentences.en: Surely that meant Rocky's days were numbered.
sentences.zh: 这肯定意味着洛奇的日子不多了。

sentences.en: But that's not how things played out.
sentences.zh: 但事情的发展并非如此。

sentences.en: Philly's largest Black Lives Matter demonstrations kicked off every day at the art museum steps.
sentences.zh: 费城规模最大的“黑人的命也是命”（Black Lives Matter）示威活动每天都在艺术博物馆台阶前开始。

sentences.en: Thousands of protesters gathered right next to the Rocky statue.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的抗议者聚集在洛奇雕像旁边。

sentences.en: And instead of being torn down or moved somewhere else,
sentences.zh: 而且它没有被拆除或搬到别处，

sentences.en: Rocky was incorporated into the rallies.
sentences.zh: 洛奇反而被融入到了集会之中。

sentences.en: So, like, where's Rocky in all of this?
sentences.zh: 那么，洛奇在这一切中扮演了什么角色？

sentences.en: Someone has put a sign on Rocky that reads,
sentences.zh: 有人在洛奇身上贴了一个标语，上面写着：

sentences.en: No justice, no peace.
sentences.zh: 没有正义，就没有和平。

sentences.en: Not only did Rocky get a role in the Black Lives Matter protests,
sentences.zh: 洛奇不仅在“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动中扮演了角色，

sentences.en: but people started using him for other causes,
sentences.zh: 人们还开始将他用于其他事业，

sentences.en: putting all sorts of stuff on his bronze body.
sentences.zh: 把各种各样的东西放在他的铜像身体上。

sentences.en: You have a face mask in the early days of the lockdown.
sentences.zh: 在封锁初期，你看到他戴着口罩。

sentences.en: You have a Ukrainian flag.
sentences.zh: 你看到他身上有乌克兰国旗。

sentences.en: When the Eagles' famed defensive end, Brandon Graham, retires,
sentences.zh: 当老鹰队著名的防守端锋布兰登·格雷厄姆（Brandon Graham）退役时，

sentences.en: he puts his cleats on Rocky.
sentences.zh: 他把自己的球鞋挂在了洛奇身上。

sentences.en: Rocky became this container for the city's complicated
sentences.zh: 洛奇成为了这座城市复杂

sentences.en: and sometimes contradictory emotions.
sentences.zh: 且有时相互矛盾的情绪的容器。

sentences.en: Paul saw this on a day early in the pandemic
sentences.zh: 保罗在疫情初期的一天看到了这一幕，

sentences.en: when he looked at the line of people waiting to take pictures with the statue.
sentences.zh: 当时他看着排队等待与雕像合影的人群。

sentences.en: So, there's a Black family, and as they're posing for a photo,
sentences.zh: 有一个黑人家庭，当他们摆姿势拍照时，

sentences.en: everyone holds up the Black Power Fist of Solidarity.
sentences.zh: 每个人都举起了象征团结的“黑人力量”拳头。

sentences.en: And three or four people later, there's, like, a group of white guys,
sentences.zh: 而在三四个人之后，有一群白人小伙子，

sentences.en: I think they were in their early 20s,
sentences.zh: 我想他们大概20出头，

sentences.en: hold up a white power sign.
sentences.zh: 举起了一个“白人力量”的手势。

sentences.en: So, these two things are happening almost together, but not confrontationally?
sentences.zh: 所以，这两件事几乎同时发生，但并没有发生冲突？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: The Rocky statue could hold all of this.
sentences.zh: 洛奇雕像能够容纳这一切。

sentences.en: Whether you liked it or hated it, thought it was beautiful or ugly,
sentences.zh: 无论你喜欢它还是讨厌它，认为它美还是丑，

sentences.en: agreed with the person next to you in line, or found their views abhorrent,
sentences.zh: 是同意排在你旁边的人的观点，还是觉得他们的观点令人厌恶，

sentences.en: the statue had become linked to the whole city.
sentences.zh: 这座雕像已经与整个城市紧密相连。

sentences.en: It was like a song everyone in Philly knew,
sentences.zh: 它就像一首费城每个人都知道的歌，

sentences.en: and people could remix it in lots of ways,
sentences.zh: 人们可以用各种方式重新混音，

sentences.en: so that it meant something just for them.
sentences.zh: 让它对每个人都有独特的意义。

sentences.en: In 2020, the Frank Rizzo statue got moved into storage.
sentences.zh: 2020年，弗兰克·里佐雕像被移入仓库。

sentences.en: The Columbus statue had a plywood box placed over it
sentences.zh: 哥伦布雕像被一个胶合板箱子罩住，

sentences.en: while the city decided what to do with it.
sentences.zh: 同时市政府决定如何处理它。

sentences.en: But Rocky?
sentences.zh: 但洛奇呢？

sentences.en: His statue has only gotten more popular.
sentences.zh: 他的雕像反而越来越受欢迎。

sentences.en: Paul Farber guest-curated a show about boxing at the Philadelphia Museum of Art.
sentences.zh: 保罗·法伯曾在费城艺术博物馆客座策划了一个关于拳击的展览。

sentences.en: And what did the exhibition feature?
sentences.zh: 展览的主题是什么呢？

sentences.en: None other than the statue that had been repeatedly kicked off its steps.
sentences.zh: 正是那座曾多次被赶下台阶的雕像。

sentences.en: Paul had moved it from the bottom of the steps to inside the museum for the show.
sentences.zh: 保罗为了展览将它从台阶底部移到了博物馆内。

sentences.en: Once that was over, Rocky moved again back outside.
sentences.zh: 展览结束后，洛奇又回到了外面。

sentences.en: And this time, it was right where Stallone had always wanted it,
sentences.zh: 这一次，它正好处于史泰龙一直想要的位置，

sentences.en: at the top of the museum's steps.
sentences.zh: 在博物馆台阶的顶端。

sentences.en: Permanently.
sentences.zh: 永久地。

sentences.en: At least for now.
sentences.zh: 至少目前是这样。

sentences.en: Read the Philly Inquirer any week,
sentences.zh: 每周读读《费城问询报》，

sentences.en: and you'll see there's still deep disagreement
sentences.zh: 你就会发现人们仍然存在深刻的分歧，

sentences.en: about whether this is the right place for it.
sentences.zh: 关于这里是否是它合适的位置。

sentences.en: Some people think the statue has found its rightful home.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为这座雕像找到了它应有的归宿。

sentences.en: Others hate that it clogs up the museum plaza,
sentences.zh: 另一些人则讨厌它堵塞了博物馆广场，

sentences.en: with vendors selling Rocky-related tchotchkes.
sentences.zh: 还有兜售洛奇相关小商品的摊贩。

sentences.en: And others are just tired of talking about it.
sentences.zh: 还有些人只是厌倦了讨论它。

sentences.en: In an additional move that some see as a tribute,
sentences.zh: 在另一项被一些人视为致敬，

sentences.en: and others as a consolation prize,
sentences.zh: 而被另一些人视为安慰奖的举措中，

sentences.en: Joe Frazier's statue has been moved to Rocky's old spot,
sentences.zh: 乔·弗雷泽的雕像被移到了洛奇原来的位置，

sentences.en: at the bottom of the museum's steps.
sentences.zh: 在博物馆台阶的底部。

sentences.en: And a little to the side.
sentences.zh: 并且稍微偏向一边。

sentences.en: When this started, there was a sense that it was Rocky
sentences.zh: 当这一切开始时，有一种感觉是洛奇

sentences.en: fighting to get to the top of the museum's steps.
sentences.zh: 在努力奋斗以到达博物馆台阶的顶端。

sentences.en: And there were people against that.
sentences.zh: 而且有人反对这一点。

sentences.en: So, like, did Rocky win?
sentences.zh: 那么，洛奇赢了吗？

sentences.en: I don't think that there is a simple winner.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有一个简单的赢家。

sentences.en: Let the never-ending Rocky series show us
sentences.zh: 让永无止境的《洛奇》系列向我们展示吧。

sentences.en: that what we're seeing right now
sentences.zh: 我们现在所看到的

sentences.en: is just another chapter in a story that will keep unfolding.
sentences.zh: 只是一个不断展开的故事中的又一个篇章。

sentences.en: Monuments are not conclusions.
sentences.zh: 纪念碑并非终点。

sentences.en: They're not periods at the end of a sentence.
sentences.zh: 它们不是句末的句号。

sentences.en: Nothing is forever.
sentences.zh: 没有什么是永恒的。

sentences.en: No monument is permanent.
sentences.zh: 没有哪座纪念碑是永久的。

sentences.en: Every champion throws the last punch.
sentences.zh: 每一位冠军都有打出最后一拳的时候。

sentences.en: Even Rocky had to hang up his gloves eventually.
sentences.zh: 就连洛奇最终也得挂起他的拳击手套。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 这是事实。

sentences.en: Nothing in this world lasts forever.
sentences.zh: 世间万物皆非永恒。

sentences.en: Except maybe the sequels.
sentences.zh: 除了续集可能除外。
